name: Picture Adjustments
author: Vestra Player
punchline: Color, image processing, aspect ratio, crop, rotation and HDR
description:
Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation and hue; image processing such as sharpening, denoising and deblocking; flip, rotation, deinterlacing and frame doubling; aspect ratio, crop/stretch and zooming and panning the frame; with GPU rendering also HDR tone mapping, pixel shaders and motion interpolation.
Everything is in the Picture panel beside the video: press Alt+1, or right-click Adjustments and Effects and pick the Picture tab. Each control shows its key.
